2122863350618972661.en_summary: @SpaceInvestor_D on $ASTS: ULA's Vulcan failure probe now centers on the BE-4 powered core stage. ULA says low booster performance just after liftoff left the stage too low and too slow to reach orbit, 40 Amazon Leo satellites lost. Ars sources say engineers looking at one BE-4 running at lower thrust and never throttling back up. Early data points to the propellant feed, not the engine itself. New Glenn's January return hangs on the answer.
